violations.text: Staff observed rinsing dishes in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Staff informed to cease practice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of biofilm debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service; ice disposed. PIC informed inspector that maintenance service was scheduled for 5/27/26. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Cases of water were observed stored on the floor in the storage area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC placed on shelving. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Staff took utensils to be cleaned and sanitized; placed in dry container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2025
The floor in the storage area is in need of resealing. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026
The wall in the kitchen was observed with a hole in plaster. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2025
